thread:
monitor-bot: ALERT: 5xx rate spike detected for /v1/generate across us-east-1 hosted cluster. 5xx% = 12.3% (SLO breach).

sophie: Seeing it too. Spike started ~2:12m ago after the staged traffic shift to traffic-tier-2. Error breakdown: 502 gateway and 503 model-serving.

maria: Any recent config flips? I see a rollout that moved 25% traffic -> tier-2 (flag: staged_traffic_shift=true) at 1965439800.

ash: I toggled the batching optimization flag yesterday but that was only for dedicated. Not sure related. Which hostpool is affected?

sophie: Affected hostpool: hosted-gen-eu/us-east shared. Example error from gateway logs: "upstream read timeout from model-proxy-03" and model logs show "kv cache miss cascade -> OOM? returning 503".

kevin: Reproduced with curl from a customer region: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -d '{"model":"rw1-large","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 502 Bad Gateway, body: "upstream timed out".

maria: @sophie can you share the exact rollout steps? I want to rollback the staged traffic shift if we confirm correlation.

sophie: rollout command used: `rctl rollout traffic-tier-2 --percent 25 --strategy=linear --flag staged_traffic_shift=true` — applied by deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Triggered traffic change: rollout-id=rl_2026_04_15_02. Noting previous revision r=20260414_2312.

ash: Trying quick healthcheck on model proxies: `for p in model-proxy-0{1..4}; do ssh $p 'journalctl -u model-proxy | tail -n 50'; done` — seeing repeated "KVCacheShard eviction thrash" and lots of `MemoryError` like traces.

kevin: If memory thrash on proxies, staged traffic increased concurrent seq-len distribution and pushed caching policy over threshold. That would explain 503s when proxies can't allocate.

maria: Rolling back staged_traffic_shift to previous state now. Command: `rctl rollback rollout-id=rl_2026_04_15_02` — pausing traffic shift.

deploy-bot: Rollback started for rl_2026_04_15_02. Target percent -> 0 over 2m.

support-bot: Customer-facing ticket updates: several customers reported increased 502/503s. Marked incident P1, informing CS.

ash: After rollback starting, I'm seeing 5xx drop in telemetry — from 12% -> 3.1% in 3m window. Latency also improving.

sophie: Confirmed. Post-rollback metrics look back to baseline. Root cause hypothesis: staged traffic brought hot-key/prefix patterns that cause KV cache eviction cascade on model-proxy variant v2.4. Patch plan: limit staged concurrency + tune cache retention + revert the v2.4 proxy image.

kevin: For short term: keep rollback, disable staged_traffic_shift until we have cache metrics and can do a slower ramp with synthetic tests. Also add auto-protect to prevent >20% shift if cache pressure > 70%.

maria: I'll open a follow-up runbook and schedule postmortem. Adding owners: @sophie (incident lead), @ash (runtime), @kevin (prod infra), @maria (deploy).

support-bot: Notified affected customers with interim advisory.

sophie: Thanks everyone. Saving logs and traces to incident bundle: s3://redwood-incidents/1965439999-bundle.tar.gz. We'll run deeper repro matrix tomorrow against v2.4 proxies.

kevin: One action item before closing: add a quick smoke test that simulates prefix-heavy traffic pattern during rollout canaries. I'll PR it. :thumbsup:

maria: Closing slack thread for now — monitoring until full recovery window. Will update with postmortem link. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
